The left column plots show the maximum activation value (y-axis) for various gating components—'atten_output', 'atten_residual', 'fm_output', and 'fm_residual'—against the layer index (x-axis, ranging from 0 to 21). The right column plots show the first token attention score (y-axis) for the same components against the layer index (x-axis, ranging from 0 to 21). In Row 1 (Baseline), the left plot shows a sharp rise in activation values starting around layer 6, with 'atten_output' reaching approximately 1400 and 'fm_output' reaching approximately 1600 by layer 21. The right plot shows the first token attention score for 'atten_output' fluctuating between 0.0 and 0.8, with a mean of 0.467. In Row 2 (SDPA Gating), the left plot shows a similar activation pattern but with reduced activations and no attention sinks, while the right plot shows a lower mean attention score of 0.468. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid) show activation patterns resembling the baseline, with 'atten_output' reaching approximately 1400 and 'fm_output' reaching approximately 1600 by layer 21, while the attention scores show a mean of 0.461 and 0.361 respectively.
